objective: Evaluate one frozen historical DRA V1 entry-admission mechanism on the exact sealed pre-2025 H1 corpus. Under identical 250 USDT initial equity and effective 240 USDT whole-lot capacity, compare the unchanged DRA V1 parent with one candidate that admits an otherwise qualifying DRA signal only when the current complete UTC-day close is strictly above the simple average of the prior 200 complete UTC-day closes. Keep every DRA V1 arm, expiry, cooldown, next-open fill, lot, fee, adverse-slippage and profit-only exit rule unchanged. Use fixed Design 2019-2022, historical Validation 2023-2024 and annual 2020-2024 folds. Retain the long-trend admission prior for one later frozen hypothesis only if total and realized PnL, drawdown, holding, underwater duration, annual breadth and concentration all pass the frozen rule; otherwise close the family. This is post-hoc historical development evidence with no clean OOS, not independent alpha, a candidate, a runtime filter or Trading authorization.

inputs.locator: Decision feature: CURRENT_COMPLETE_UTC_DAY_CLOSE_ABOVE_PRIOR_200_COMPLETE_DAY_SMA. At each original DRA V1 decision close, compare that complete UTC-day close with the arithmetic mean of exactly the prior 200 complete UTC-day closes; admit only when strictly above. At hard data inception only, fewer than 200 prior days must fall back to admitting the unchanged parent signal and must be counted. No current incomplete day, later bar, EMA substitute, threshold, neighbor or parameter sweep is permitted.

Frozen windows and accounting: Design is [2019-01-01T00:00:00Z, 2023-01-01T00:00:00Z); historical Validation is [2023-01-01T00:00:00Z, 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z); annual folds are calendar 2020 through 2024. Both ledgers start at 250 USDT equity and use effective 240 USDT whole-lot capacity, eight possible independent 30 USDT lots, 0.10 percent fee per side, 0.05 percent adverse slippage per side, next-open fills, unchanged DRA V1 seven-day cooldown and plus-5-percent exit with the positive next-open fill guard. Historical Validation is not clean OOS.

Frozen parent parity checkpoints before candidate access: the parent must reproduce Design realized 169.89846767, unrealized -79.12049441, total 90.77797326 USDT, 100 buys, 95 sells, five open lots, three blocked entries, median 126.0h and P90 1818.6h; Validation realized 89.41118307, unrealized -3.20820121, total 86.20298186 USDT, 51 buys, 50 sells, one open lot, zero blocked entries, median 182.5h and P90 1418.3h. Equal-equity path metrics are additional diagnostics and may not replace these checkpoints.

Frozen positive rule: data, source, parent parity and admission accounting pass; Validation and every annual fold have zero inception fallbacks; Design and Validation each have at least one veto. In both windows candidate total PnL is strictly higher, realized PnL nonlower, drawdown strictly lower, median and P90 hold nonhigher, and maximum underwater duration nonhigher. Across 2020-2024, total PnL is strictly higher in at least 4/5 folds, realized nonlower in at least 4/5, and drawdown strictly lower in at least 4/5. The largest positive annual total-PnL delta is at most 50 percent of the positive-delta sum. All admission, realized, unrealized, total, drawdown, utilization, blocked-entry, holding, underwater and terminal-inventory fields are visible. Every gate passes; no rescue variant.
